title: 上海高考翻译背诵-86-某市重

items.zh: 全职绘画博主，亦或“独立画师”，这条路好走吗?
items.en: Is this an easy path to take to be a full-time painting blogger—in other words, an independent painter?

items.zh: 长颈鹿俯身饮水，这优雅又笨拙的瞬间，会让你忍俊不禁。
items.en: The elegant and awkward moment when giraffes bend down to drink water would make you laugh.

items.zh: “十五五”规划中明确要求,政府应因地制宜、有条不紊地改善农村娱乐设施。
items.en: The 15th Five-Year Plan requires the government to methodically improve recreational facilities in rural areas in light of local conditions.

items.zh: 上海大歌剧院建设已进入冲刺阶段，其极具象征意义的“中国扇”造型将惊艳亮相，势必刷屏网络。
items.en: Entering its construction home stretch, the Shanghai Grand Opera House will be unveiled in its iconic “Chinese fan” design, bound to go viral across the Internet.
